title: musa × paradisiaca var. violacea
intro: Musa × paradisiaca var. violacea, commonly known as the purple banana, is a variety of the banana plant that has vibrant purple-colored fruit. The purple banana is rich in health benefits, including high levels of antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, which can help to boost the immune system and prevent chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of the purple banana include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of the purple banana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and health-promoting properties.
